description: Defines the quic::QuicConfig class and related enums and classes for configuring QUIC protocol parameters, including transport parameters, connection options, and handshake message handling.

classes.name: QuicConfig
classes.description: Contains non-crypto configuration options negotiated during the crypto handshake, such as stream limits, timeouts, connection IDs, and transport parameters.

classes.name: QuicConfigValue
classes.description: Abstract base class for values that can be sent in handshake messages, with methods for serialization and processing peer hello messages.

classes.name: QuicFixedUint32
classes.description: Stores uint32_t values from handshake messages, with send/receive states.

classes.name: QuicFixedUint62
classes.description: Stores 62-bit numbers from handshake messages, serialized as 32-bit unsigned integers.

classes.name: QuicFixedStatelessResetToken
classes.description: Stores StatelessResetToken values for handshake messages.

classes.name: QuicFixedTagVector
classes.description: Stores vectors of QuicTags from handshake messages.

classes.name: QuicFixedSocketAddress
classes.description: Stores QuicSocketAddress values for handshake messages.
